card.name: Yellow Colonial with Porch
card.summary: A two-story yellow colonial house with a large front porch, red mailbox, and blue swing on an empty lot.
card.description: This two-story colonial residence presents a warm, inviting facade painted in a vibrant yellow hue, standing prominently on a cleared lot. The structure measures approximately 13.00 meters in width and 10.00 meters in depth, with a total height of 6.50 meters including the roof. The exterior walls are clad in durable vinyl siding, while the roof is covered in dark grey asphalt shingles, providing a classic contrast to the bright walls. A large, covered front porch spans the width of the entrance, supported by sturdy white columns, creating a welcoming space for outdoor relaxation. On the porch, a blue wooden swing is mounted, offering a playful touch, while a red mailbox stands near the front gate, adding a pop of color. The house features six bedrooms and two bathrooms, distributed across the two floors, with a spacious living area on the ground level. The design incorporates large windows to allow natural light to flood the interior, enhancing the open and airy feel of the home. The overall aesthetic is traditional yet functional, ideal for a family seeking comfort and style in a suburban setting.
plan: Measure the lot dimensions and mark the foundation layout using stakes and string lines to ensure the house is square and level.
Draft the architectural plans, detailing the placement of the two-story structure, the large front porch, and the interior layout of six bedrooms and two bathrooms.
Pour the concrete foundation and allow it to cure, ensuring it is level and properly reinforced to support the weight of the two-story frame.
Erect the wooden frame, installing the floor joists, wall studs, and roof trusses according to the blueprint, securing all connections with nails and screws.
Install the exterior vinyl siding in yellow, the dark grey asphalt shingles on the roof, and the large front porch with white columns and a blue swing.
Fit the interior drywall, paint the walls, install the flooring, and complete the plumbing and electrical systems for the two bathrooms and six bedrooms.
Place the red mailbox near the front gate and perform a final inspection of the structure, ensuring all doors, windows, and fixtures are functional and secure.
assumptions: The house is assumed to be a colonial style based on the reference designs and the two-story requirement.
The wall material is assumed to be vinyl siding as it is a common and cost-effective choice for residential homes.
The roof is assumed to be covered in asphalt shingles, which is a standard roofing material for this type of house.
The interior layout is assumed to include six bedrooms and two bathrooms, distributed across the two floors to maximize space.
